levels.low: Diagnostic parameters concatenated directly without filtering. Traversal and XML entities fully enabled.
levels.medium: Filters semicolons and double-ampersand, single-pass replaces '../', and case-sensitive checks 'SYSTEM'.
levels.high: Unanchored regex allows commands after valid IPs. Absolute file paths permitted. Internal XML entities allowed.
levels.impossible: Strict IP/hostname regex enforcement, basename-only file allowlist, and external DTD/entity expansion disabled.

hints.low: The diagnostic tool concatenates input directly into shell execution strings. Command terminators allow executing secondary programs.
hints.medium: The application filters semicolons and double-ampersands. Are there other stream redirection or piping operators available in Unix shells?
hints.high: The input filter validates that the target string starts with an IP address, but fails to check if anything follows it.
hints.impossible: Use parameterised APIs, strict input allowlisting, and avoid invoking system command interpreters.
